note: ids are never reused; 1-127 official, 128-255 custom. Every effect takes a palette: palette 254 = colour 1 -> 2 -> 3, 255 = Effect default: default_palette_id, or the effect's own colours when default_palette is "own". colors = how many of c1..c3 the effect uses, color_slots = their labels by position (null: that slot is unused); palette_slots = the colour slots it still uses while a palette is chosen, palette_note = what the palette colours; speed / intensity: true when used; the labels say what they do; custom1 / custom2: null or a label. A retired id would stay with retired: true.

effects.name: Solid
effects.summary: One colour; fades smoothly to another (the transition).
effects.palette_note: With a palette: the palette laid end to end along the strip, standing still.

effects.name: Breathe
effects.summary: The colour swells and fades like breathing.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: the palette laid along the strip breathes in and out as one.

effects.name: Colorloop
effects.summary: The whole strip cycles through the hues.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: the whole strip cycles through the palette; Saturation still whitens it.

effects.name: Rainbow
effects.summary: A rainbow moves along the strip.
effects.intensity_label: Size (128: one rainbow per strip, doubling every 32)
effects.palette_note: With a palette: the palette moves along the strip at the rainbow's pace.

effects.name: Palette
effects.summary: The chosen palette moves along the strip.
effects.intensity_label: Size (128: one palette per strip, doubling every 32)
effects.palette_note: With a palette: the palette runs along the strip and scrolls slowly.

effects.name: Colorwaves
effects.summary: Slow, ever-changing waves of palette colour.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: the palette sweeps back and forth along the strip in waves of brightness.

effects.name: Pride 2015
effects.summary: Animated, ever-changing rainbows (not palette-based).
effects.palette_note: With a palette: the bright waves run through the palette instead of the rainbow.

effects.name: Sinelon
effects.summary: A dot sweeps back and forth, trailing a fading tail.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: the swinging dot slowly cycles through the palette (about 11 s a round).
effects.origin: FastLED DemoReel100 sinelon (Mark Kriegsman, MIT), tail computed instead of faded

effects.name: Twinklefox
effects.summary: Twinkling holiday lights that fade in and out.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: each twinkle takes a palette colour, a new one each time it lights.

effects.name: Colortwinkles
effects.summary: Pixels light up in random palette colours and fade away.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: each twinkle takes a random palette colour.

effects.name: Candle
effects.summary: The whole strip flickers like a candle.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: the palette laid along the strip flickers as one flame.

effects.name: Candle Multi
effects.summary: Every pixel flickers on its own like a candle.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: every pixel flickers on its own, in its colour of the palette laid along the strip.

effects.name: Aurora
effects.summary: Drifting curtains of northern-light colour.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: which of the two drifting curtains leads picks the palette colour.

effects.name: Blends
effects.summary: A smooth rippling wash of the palette's colours that drifts along.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: the palette ripples back and forth along the strip and drifts through.

effects.name: Flow
effects.summary: Zones that each show the palette, flowing in turn in opposite directions.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: each zone shows the whole palette, neighbours flowing in opposite ways.

effects.name: Fire 2012
effects.summary: Flames rising from the start of the strip.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: the heat runs through the palette, coolest to hottest.

effects.name: Gradient
effects.summary: Colour 1 to colour 2 to colour 3 across the strip.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: the palette runs across the strip instead of colours 1-2-3, repeating and scrolling as set.

effects.name: Pacifica
effects.summary: Gentle blue-green ocean waves.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: the waves take the palette's colours, dark troughs to bright crests; the whitecaps stay white.
effects.origin: FastLED Pacifica (Mark Kriegsman, Mary Corey March), MIT

effects.name: Sunrise
effects.summary: A slow wake-up: dark, red, orange, warm white.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: each pixel moves from the palette's start to its end as the sun rises.

effects.name: Sunset
effects.summary: The wake-up backwards: warm white to dark, and it stays dark.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: each pixel moves from the palette's end back to its start as it sets.

effects.name: Glitter
effects.summary: A palette backdrop with short sparkles.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: the palette drifts slowly along the strip, twice over; the sparkles stay Sparkle.

effects.name: Meteor
effects.summary: A meteor with a shimmering tail runs along the strip.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: the head takes the palette's last colour and the tail runs back through it to the first.

effects.name: Fairy
effects.summary: Sparse, soft, slow twinkles like fairy lights.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: each slow twinkle takes a random palette colour.

effects.name: Plasma
effects.summary: Smooth overlapping waves through the palette.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: three moving waves add up to pick the palette colour along the strip.

effects.name: Noise
effects.summary: Drifting smooth noise through the palette.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: slowly drifting noise picks the palette colour along the strip.

effects.name: Running
effects.summary: Waves of colour 1 on colour 2 run along the strip.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: the waves carry the palette along the strip; the troughs go dark.

effects.name: Ripples
effects.summary: Raindrops on a pond: soft rings spread out and fade.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: each ring takes a random palette colour.
effects.custom1: Rain (how many of the drops fall; 0: none)

effects.name: Wipe
effects.summary: One colour wipes over the other along the strip, then back.
effects.intensity_label: Hold (0: none, 255: three quarters of the cycle)
effects.palette_note: With a palette: with Colours 128 and up, each wipe brings a new palette colour.
effects.custom1: Colours (0-127: Colour 1 and 2 alternate, 128-255: a new palette colour each wipe)

effects.name: Stripes
effects.summary: Hard stripes of colour 1 and colour 2 move along the strip (candy cane).
effects.palette_note: With a palette: the stripes take the palette's 16 colours in turn, hard-edged as ever.

effects.name: Bulbs
effects.summary: A string of coloured bulbs; the colours hop along it.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: the bulbs step through the palette by Colour step; the colours hop along.
effects.custom1: Bulb size (share of the spacing, 128: half)
effects.custom2: Colour step (64: a quarter of the palette)

effects.name: Lava Lamp
effects.summary: Big soft blobs of palette colour drift and merge.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: the three blobs take colours a third apart, turning about once a minute.

effects.name: Mosaic Drift
effects.summary: Fixed adjoining tiles that slowly melt from one colour to the next.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: each tile melts from one random palette colour to another.

effects.name: Silk Weave
effects.summary: Two broad ribbons of light slide through each other and turn pearly where they cross.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: each ribbon carries the palette along its length, the two half a palette apart.

effects.name: Canopy Shade
effects.summary: A pale wash with soft leaf-like shadows that breathe and lean a little.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: the wash is the palette laid along the strip; the leaf shadows darken it.

effects.name: Opal Facets
effects.summary: Fixed glass-like facets in palette colours; a pearly reflection rolls across each one.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: each facet takes a random palette colour.

effects.name: Quiet Landings
effects.summary: One to three soft pearls rise and fall in arcs and touch down without a trail.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: the pearls take the palette's colours at its start, a third and two thirds.
